roadmap.title: Tutorial and playlists
roadmap.description: Finish the tutorial, then play playlists and use their challenge, feat and photo op tabs. Pick up the quick one-time actions: fast travel, treasure, photos and a full rewind.

roadmap.title: Open-world stunts and landmarks
roadmap.description: Do the location and stunt achievements in free roam: donuts, flying, bridges, the volcano and the map edge.

roadmap.title: Progression, shop and competitive modes
roadmap.description: Earn Bucks and vehicles, buy the shop items some stunts need, and play the Summit Contest and Custom Show.

roadmap.title: Crew and PvP matches
roadmap.description: Team up with friends and play Grand Race and Demolition Royale, which also fill the Compete timeline. Finish the Main Stage timelines last. Demolition Royale kills and monster-truck transformations are the hardest tasks.

achievements.description: Complete 15 Motorfest Events
achievements.summary: Complete 15 Motorfest events.

steps.text: Finish any 15 events. Your finishing place does not matter.

achievements.description: Complete all three timelines on the Motorfest Main Stage
achievements.summary: Complete all three Main Stage timelines: Revisit, Compete and Explore.

guide.context: Each timeline has four ranks. The Main Stage resets at the end of each month, so finish all three in the same month.

steps.text: Open the @loc{Main Stage} menu and select each timeline to see how it earns XP.
Revisit (blue XP): complete playlist events.
Compete (orange XP): play Grand Race, Demolition Royale, Summit Contest or Custom Show.
Explore (green XP): do open-world activities such as challenges, photo ops, feats and treasure chests.
Reach rank 4 on all three timelines.

achievements.description: Complete your Motorfest welcome for the first time
achievements.summary: Complete the Motorfest welcome tutorial.

steps.text: Play through the opening welcome tutorial to its end.

achievements.description: Complete a Playlist for the first time
achievements.summary: Complete one playlist by finishing all of its events.

steps.text: Finish every event in any one playlist.

achievements.description: Complete 30 Challenges
achievements.summary: Complete 30 challenges.

guide.context: Challenges are side activities that belong to a playlist. Each new playlist you start unlocks more.

steps.text: Open a playlist menu and select the Challenges tab to see its list.
Complete challenges across your playlists until you reach 30.

achievements.displayName: Cars, bikes, rides and good vibes
achievements.description: Complete 6 Playlists
achievements.summary: Complete 6 playlists.

steps.text: Finish all events in any 6 playlists.

achievements.description: Win 5 custom events in the same session
achievements.summary: Win 5 custom events in one session.

guide.context: Custom events open in a playlist only after you complete that playlist. You may replay the same event.

steps.text: Finish a playlist.
In the event settings, switch from Playlist to Custom.
Win five custom events without ending your session.

achievements.description: Reach Level 15
achievements.summary: Reach player level 15.

guide.context: Main Stage ranks turn into player levels only when the month ends. Finishing the three timelines (12 ranks) and Legend rank 3 gives 15.

steps.text: Finish all three Main Stage timelines.
Reach rank 3 on the Legend track.
Wait for the monthly Main Stage reset, then check your player level.

achievements.description: Spend 1 Million Bucks in one purchase
achievements.summary: Spend 1,000,000 Bucks in a single purchase.

steps.text: Save up Bucks.
Buy one bundle or expensive vehicle from the shop that costs at least 1,000,000 Bucks.

achievements.description: Own 30 Vehicles
achievements.summary: Own 30 vehicles.

guide.context: Finishing playlists awards vehicles, and the shop sells more.

steps.text: Finish playlists to earn vehicles and buy others in the shop until you own 30.

achievements.description: Spend 24 Hours in The Crew Motorfest
achievements.summary: Play The Crew Motorfest for 24 hours in total.

steps.text: Keep playing. Time spent in any mode counts toward the total.

achievements.description: Own a vehicle in 10 different vehicle categories
achievements.summary: Hold vehicles from 10 separate vehicle categories.

guide.context: There are 14 categories: Plane, Powerboat, Monster, Demolition, Rally, Rally Raid, Motocross, Alpha GP, Hypercar, Dragster, Racing, Drift, Street Tier 2 and Street Tier 1.

steps.text: Check which categories you already own a vehicle in.
Buy vehicles in the missing categories from the shop until you cover 10.

achievements.description: Reach maximum level on one vehicle
achievements.summary: Raise one vehicle to its maximum level.

guide.context: Maximum level means the highest performance score for that vehicle's category, such as 750 for a Street Tier 2 car.

steps.text: Equip one vehicle.
Improve its gear as you progress until its performance score reaches the category maximum.

achievements.description: Become a Motorfest Legend for the first time
achievements.summary: Reach the Legend track on the Main Stage for the first time.

steps.text: Reach rank 4 on any one Main Stage timeline to unlock the Legend track.

achievements.displayName: A e s t h e t i c
achievements.description: Complete 20 Photo Ops
achievements.summary: Complete 20 photo ops.

guide.context: Photo ops are playlist photo tasks. If one needs a certain time of day or weather, set it in photo mode instead of waiting.

steps.text: Open a playlist's Side Activities tab to see its photo ops.
Take the photo each one asks for.
Repeat until you complete 20.

achievements.description: Perform 31 Different Motorfest Feats
achievements.summary: Complete 31 different Motorfest feats.

guide.context: Feats are short driving tasks, such as reaching a set speed or driving through checkpoints. Each new playlist unlocks more.

steps.text: Open a playlist's Side Activities tab to see its feats.
Complete feats across your playlists until you reach 31.

achievements.description: Use the fast travel feature for the first time
achievements.summary: Use fast travel for the first time.

steps.text: Open the map, select any unlocked event or container, and choose fast travel (Y on a controller).

achievements.description: Chain a 15 actions combo with Dynamic Freestyle
achievements.summary: Build a 15-action Dynamic Freestyle combo.

guide.context: Actions include drifting, near misses and high-speed driving. Switching to another vehicle in the middle of the combo lets you add more actions.

steps.text: Start a combo with a car and build about 7 different actions.
Switch quickly to a plane and add the other 8 actions before the combo ends.

achievements.description: Find and open a Treasure
achievements.summary: Find and open a treasure chest.

steps.text: Roam the open world until a beeping starts; it speeds up as you near the box.
Find the box and hold X (controller) to open it.

achievements.description: Travel 40 Kilometers (25 miles) anywhere in Hawaii in the same session
achievements.summary: Travel 40 km (25 miles) in Hawaii in one session.

steps.text: Drive around the open world until your distance in the session reaches 40 km.

achievements.description: Take 3 photos in the same session
achievements.summary: Take 3 photos in one session.

steps.text: Open photo mode and take 3 photos anywhere. Any photo counts, not only photo op shots.

achievements.description: Reach the summit of the volcano with a ground vehicle
achievements.summary: Land a ground vehicle on the volcano summit.

guide.context: You can fly to the summit and switch to a car in the air.

steps.text: Go to the top of the volcano.
If you are flying, switch to a car while in the air.
Land the car on top of the summit.

achievements.description: Fly under 5 differents bridges in the same session
achievements.summary: Fly under 5 different bridges in one session.

steps.text: Switch to a plane.
Follow a river and fly under 5 different bridges.

achievements.description: Stay still for 1 minute on the beach in front of the Royal Hawaiian Hotel
achievements.summary: Wait one minute without moving on the beach by the Royal Hawaiian Hotel.

steps.text: Go to the Royal Hawaiian Hotel and park on its beachfront.
Stay motionless for 60 seconds.

achievements.description: Fly as high as possible
achievements.summary: Fly a plane up to the maximum altitude.

steps.text: Switch to any plane and fly straight up until you hit the height limit. This takes a while.

achievements.description: Perform a donut move in the Ubisoft logo
achievements.summary: Do a donut inside the Ubisoft logo.

steps.text: Find the Ubisoft logo in the Central area, just east of the volcano.
Drive any car in circles in the middle of the logo: accelerate, brake and steer left or right.

achievements.description: Join, or form a Crew
achievements.summary: Join or form a Crew.

steps.text: Invite a friend to your group, or accept an invite to join theirs.

achievements.description: Complete a custom event with a Crew of 4 players
achievements.summary: Finish a custom event in a group of 4 players.

guide.context: Custom events open in a playlist only after you complete it. All party members get the achievement.

steps.text: Form a Crew of 4 players.
In the event settings, switch from Playlist to Custom.
Finish a custom event together. If it does not unlock, finish a different custom event.

achievements.description: Fully customize one vehicle (Visual parts and Livery)
achievements.summary: Fully customize one vehicle, changing every visual part and livery category.

guide.context: Not every vehicle can be fully customized. The Jeep Wrangler from the shop works.

steps.text: Open Vehicles, then Customize.
Equip any option in every Visual Parts category.
Equip any option in every Livery category.

achievements.description: Drive or Fly 5 Km in formation with a Crew member, in the same session
achievements.summary: Cover 5 km while flying or driving in formation with a teammate from your Crew, in one session.

steps.text: Form a Crew.
Stay close to your teammate until the Formation action shows on screen.
Keep it up for 5 km.

achievements.description: Participate in a Grand Race event
achievements.summary: Participate in a Grand Race.

guide.context: A Grand Race is a 28-player race.

steps.text: Start Grand Race matchmaking from the menu and finish the race. Your finishing place does not matter.

achievements.description: Complete a Summit Contest event
achievements.summary: Complete one Summit Contest event.

guide.context: A new Summit Contest with 9 activities starts every week.

steps.text: Open the activities menu and choose Summit Contest.
Finish any one of its events.

achievements.displayName: I've got a crash on you
achievements.description: Participate in a Demolition Royale event
achievements.summary: Participate in a Demolition Royale event.

guide.context: Demolition Royale is a battle royale where players damage each other's cars until one team remains.

steps.text: Start Demolition Royale from the menu and finish one game.

achievements.description: Destroy 3 vehicles in Demolition Royale in the same session
achievements.summary: Destroy 3 vehicles in one Demolition Royale game.

guide.context: The count is per game, not per session. Pick up as many power-ups as you can and go after cars that are already damaged.

steps.text: Join a Demolition Royale game.
Collect power-ups.
Focus on damaged cars and destroy 3 in the same game. This can take several tries.

achievements.description: Overtake 12 players in the Grand Race in the same session
achievements.summary: Pass 12 other players during a single Grand Race.

steps.text: Join a Grand Race.
Overtake 12 players, ideally right at the start.

achievements.description: Submit 1 vehicle to the Custom show
achievements.summary: Submit one vehicle to the Custom Show.

guide.context: The vehicle must meet the show's requirements, which change every week.

steps.text: Fast travel to the car meet.
Stand in front of the register-your-car platform and press A.
Customize and submit a car that meets the requirements. If you lack one, buy one in the shop or wait for the next show.

achievements.description: Vote for 5 cars in the Custom show in the same session
achievements.summary: Cast votes for 5 cars at the Custom Show within one session.

steps.text: Fast travel to the car meet.
Walk up to a car and press A to vote.
Vote for 5 cars.

achievements.displayName: Not so lonely at the top
achievements.description: Complete all activities of a Summit Contest
achievements.summary: Complete all 9 activities of one Summit Contest.

steps.text: Finish all 9 events in the current Summit Contest.
If you lack a required car, buy it in the shop or wait for next week's contest.

achievements.description: Complete 5 events in Main Stage Mode in the same session
achievements.summary: Finish 5 Main Stage events in one session.

guide.context: The Main Stage unlocks after you complete at least 3 playlists.

steps.text: Open the Main Stage menu and select Revisit Playlist Experience.
Drive to the marked location and finish the event.
Complete 5 events in the same session. You may replay one event.

achievements.description: Transform into a monster truck twice in a single game of demolition royale
achievements.summary: Turn into a monster truck two times within a single Demolition Royale match.

guide.context: Charge the yellow meter at the screen's bottom, then press B to change into a monster truck for a short time. The second transformation needs a long survival. Damaging other players refills the bar fastest; yellow item drops fill it a little.

steps.text: Join a Demolition Royale game.
Fill the yellow bar by damaging other players, then press B.
Stay alive and refill the bar, then transform a second time in the same game.

achievements.description: Win by completing the event without hitting a wall, or track limits, driving in Ebisu Style
achievements.summary: Win an event without hitting a wall or leaving the track while driving in Ebisu Style.

guide.context: Play the event in playlist mode, not custom mode. You can lower the difficulty if the score target is too high.

steps.text: Find the Ebisu Style event in your playlist events.
Drive carefully without touching a wall or leaving the track and win.

achievements.description: Complete a Speedtrap instance with a boat
achievements.summary: Complete a Speedtrap with a boat.

steps.text: Pick a speedtrap with a low required speed and plenty of road leading to it.
Drive a fast car toward it.
Just before the speedtrap, switch to a boat, keeping your speed. Switching takes a moment, so it may take a few tries.

achievements.description: Fly through the "Rule the Streets" inflatable donut with a plane
achievements.summary: Fly a plane through the inflatable Rule the Streets donut.

steps.text: Go to the playlist container for Rule the Streets; the big donut hangs in the sky above it.
Change to a plane and pass through the ring.

achievements.description: Equip your avatar with the casual tuxedo and drive an Aston martin car
achievements.summary: Equip the casual tuxedo on your avatar and drive an Aston Martin.

steps.text: Buy the casual tuxedo for 21,000 Bucks: Profile, Driver, Avatar Customization, Clothes, Suit.
Equip it.
Switch to an Aston Martin car, buying one in the shop if needed.

achievements.description: Try to leave Hawaii (boat or plane) by reaching the limit of the map
achievements.summary: Reach the edge of the map in a boat or plane.

steps.text: Head in any direction by plane or boat until you hit the map boundary.

achievements.description: Reach 88 MPH (142 Km/h) with the Delorean DMC-12 and use the rewind feature
achievements.summary: Reach 88 mph (142 km/h) in the DeLorean DMC-12 and use rewind.

steps.text: Purchase the DeLorean DMC-12 from the shop for 387,800 Bucks.
Drive it up to 142 km/h.
Hold rewind (Y on a controller).

achievements.description: Stay in a Car meet car for 10 seconds or more
achievements.summary: Sit in a car at the car meet for 10 seconds.

steps.text: Fast travel to the car meet.
Hold LT while looking at a car to zoom, press A to open the door, then press A again to enter.
Remain inside for at least 10 seconds.

achievements.description: Use up the rewind feature fully 1 time
achievements.summary: Use up the full rewind bar once.

steps.text: Hold rewind (Y on a controller) until it reaches its maximum.

achievements.description: Perform a donut move around the pineapple shop
achievements.summary: Do a donut around the pineapple shop.

steps.text: Fast travel to the pineapple shop.
Hold both LT and RT on a controller and steer left or right.
Drive a few circles around the shop.

achievements.description: Chain two bike backflips while in the air and use fast fav with a plane, before reaching the ground
achievements.summary: Chain two bike backflips in the air, then switch to a plane before landing.

steps.text: Buy the KTM 450 EXC for 98,700 Bucks.
From the map, jump to the Red Bull Speed Clash spot and ride off the big ramp beside it. If that is not available or does not work, use another tall ramp, such as the ridge near the car meet.
In the air, hold X and push the left stick back for two backflips.
Before landing, press the right stick to switch to a plane. Assign a plane to a quick-switch slot in the vehicle menu beforehand.
